text:
alyssa: Quick heads up — were doing a rolling rollout of tokenizer-v2 tonight across hosted and dedicated. Partial release-freeze for the main release train during the canary windows (00:00-04:00 UTC) to reduce noise. Link to plan: https://go.redwood/tokenizer-v2-plan :eyes:

deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary-start=2026-03-24T00:30:00Z, regions=[eu-central, us-west], initial-traffic=5% (eu), 2% (us-west). Auto-rollout disabled.

sam: what metrics should we watch first?

alyssa: primary: tokenization_error_rate, gen_latency_p95, kv-cache-miss-rate. Secondary: cpu% on small N, memory spikes on dedicated nodes.

maria: Feature flags in play: ff.tokenizer_v2_enabled, ff.kv_cache_prefetch. We'll gate by ff.tokenizer_v2_enabled per service.

ryan: Rollback thresholds? Do we have hard numbers?

alyssa: yes. rollback if tokenization_error_rate >= 0.03 (3%) sustained for 5m OR gen_latency_p95 increases >20% vs baseline for 5m. Manual rollback if any data-corruption signal.

sam: can you paste the canary config snippet so SREs can load it into the ops dashboard?

alyssa: sure — config were using:```yaml
canary:
  start_time: "2026-03-24T00:30:00Z"
  regions:
    - name: eu-central
      pct: 5
    - name: us-west
      pct: 2
  monitor_metrics:
    - tokenization_error_rate
    - gen_latency_p95
  rollback_policy:
    error_threshold: 0.03
    latency_increase_pct: 20
```

tess: Dedicated pools — do we need manual approval to include them? Some customers run pinned models on those pools.

alyssa: yes, dedicated pools are opt-in. Ops will reach out to teams who have pinned capacity. If you need an exemption, post a note in #release-exempt with owner + reason.

oncall-ops: Oncall will be monitoring dashboards during the window. Pager rules: page if tokenization_error_rate > 0.05 OR gen_latency_p95 > 2s above baseline. We'll also watch cache-miss trends.

sam: thanks — will add quick smoke prompts to our eval harness to detect weird token splits.

maria: FYI I'll flip ff.kv_cache_prefetch to true in eu after 10m of stable canary — low risk, helps perf.

alyssa: If anyone sees unexpected 4xx/5xx spikes, call it out here immediately. After we hit 30m stable in both regions we'll expand to 25% and resume normal release train cadence.

deploy-bot: Reminder: release-freeze in effect for train from 2026-03-24T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-24T04:00:00Z. Exceptions: security patches and ops-approved hotfixes.

ryan: Adding rollback playbook to the plan now (linked).

tess: thumbs up. pinging dedicated team leads for exemptions.

alyssa: thanks all — will post a quick postmortem thread if anything notable. Otherwise Ill post rollout status after 1h. :rocket:

oncall-ops: Monitoring started.

deploy-bot: Canary started (eu-central) at 2026-03-24T00:30:12Z; initial traffic 5%.

sam: seeing tokenization_error_rate spike to 0.8% for ~2m, baseline is 0.12% — watching.

alyssa: noted. hold expansion until stable.

oncall-ops: spike contained, dropped back to 0.14%. continuing to monitor.

deploy-bot: Canary started (us-west) at 2026-03-24T00:45:10Z; initial traffic 2%.

alyssa: 35m in - eu stable, us-west stable. proceeding to 25% in eu at +40m, us-west to 10% at +45m.

maria: kv_cache_prefetch flip completed in eu at +42m, no regressions.

oncall-ops: No pages. No elevated CPU or OOMs.

ryan: rolling to 25% and monitoring latency dashboards.

alyssa: Expansion complete. Lifting partial release-freeze at 2026-03-24T01:35:00Z for low-risk non-user-facing changes. Full train freeze lifted at 04:00 UTC as planned. Great job. :tada:

sam: nice work everyone.

tess: will follow up with customer outreach list for dedicated exemptions.

deploy-bot: Canary finished: final status=success, duration=01:40:02, final_error_rate=0.11%.

alyssa: Posting short readout in #weekly-release-summary and adding notes to the runbook. If you want the raw CSV metrics ping me.
